messages:
jessica (product): Quick announcement — rolling out two coordinated changes next week: 1) SDK telemetry defaults will switch to opt-in for SDK v5.1+ (we will not collect usage unless explicitly enabled). 2) Docs search/indexing will be compacted to remove legacy snippets and publish a small redirect map. Rationale: privacy alignment + reduce noisy legacy examples. Timeline: rollout starts Tue 2026-04-01, gradual feature flag for hosted API, full SDK packages published Wed 2026-04-02. Links: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/sdk-telemetry-plan and https://redwood.internal/docs/compact-indexing (internal). :megaphone:
marc (eng): Thanks Jess. Two quick Qs — how will this affect existing customers with older SDKs pinned? And is there a migration flag we can use in infra to avoid sudden changes? @chris fyi for release notes.
sara (docs): Will update docs pages to show the new opt-in UX, add a clear migration header, and publish a short FAQ. I’ll also add a redirect for the ~30 legacy snippets we are sweeping. ETA: EOD Mon for draft updates.
chris (devex): We’ll publish an adapter helper and a small codemod to flip telemetry on for teams that depend on it. Example snippet to opt in (will be in the release notes):

```
# python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=..., telemetry_enabled=True)
```

And a CLI opt-in flag for the edge case builds: `--enable-telemetry`
marc (eng): Good. For Dedicated/Private, infra wants a flag on the runtime that preserves the old behavior until ops flips it. infra-bot, can we gate this with a rollout flag in config? :thinking:
infra-bot: Rollout flag created: `sdk.telemetry.opt_in_default` (env override available). Default for hosted will switch to true on 2026-04-01; Dedicated/Private remain unchanged until a tenant-level toggle is applied. See infra ticket: https://redwood.internal/infra/RT-8942
jessica (product): Correct — hosted: opt-in default flips. Dedicated/Private: unchanged unless tenant toggles. We'll communicate directly to enterprise CSMs and send a targeted email to tenants with >$10k/mo usage. Migration window: 60 days of overlap with both defaults supported, then 30-day deprecation notice for old default. :calendar:
sara (docs): I'll add a migration checklist and sample email templates to the docs repo under /docs/migration/sdk-telemetry. Also adding a short changelog snippet for v5.1 release notes.
chris (devex): I'll cut the codemod and a one-click toggle for code samples in the docs site so maintainers can preview with telemetry on/off. Ping me if you want a demo in the docs staging site.
marc (eng): One more: does this change have any impact on telemetry schema? We should ensure any collected events still match current prod ingestion.
jessica (product): No schema changes this release — purely opt-in default flip. If we need a schema bump we'll announce separately. :white_check_mark:
chris (devex): Quick rollout checklist for engineering: 1) publish SDK v5.1 packages with telemetry default off, 2) publish release notes + snippet, 3) enable hosted rollout flag Tue morning, 4) monitor usage/telemetry errors for 72h, 5) postmortem template ready. I’ll create the release checklist in the release repo.
sara (docs): Will publish docs PR and request reviews from @marc and @jessica. I’ll add a one-line notice banner on docs homepage the day of the flip.
jessica (product): Thanks everyone. Action items summarized: - @chris publish codemod + release checklist - @sara docs PR + redirect map - infra to enable rollout flag for hosted - Product to notify enterprise CSMs and send email. We’ll reconvene Wed 2026-04-08 for a quick post-rollout sync (15m). :rocket:
marc (eng): acked. I’ll slot the runtime flag change into the deploy window.
infra-bot: Hosted rollout flag enabled (staged) — monitoring hooks registered.
chris (devex): Demo scheduled Tue 2026-04-01 10:00 PT in #eng-release. Everyone welcome. :calendar_with_upcoming_events:
sara (docs): PR opened: https://redwood.internal/pulls/12345 — includes migration checklist and FAQ.
